title: Tabernacles/Harvest
description:
Tabernacles / Harvest is the 3rd of three annual harvest feasts to Yahweh. This feast has two different symbolisms: 1) Tabernacles - dwelling in temporary tents 2) Harvest - Celebrating the bringing in of the fruit of the land
The feast points to two different timeframes.
Past:
1) When Yahweh dwelt with the Israelites in the wilderness after leaving Egypt before entering the promised land
2) Bringing in the fall harvest once they were in the promised land
Future:
1) During the 1,000 year reign with Yahweh dwelling in the Ezekiel Temple in Jerusalem 2) The final harvest of saints at the great white throne judgement before entering the new heaven and earth with Yahweh (Harvest is a metaphor for gathering people into God's kingdom - eg the sower, the seed and the crop)
